partial_results: The written proof covers all photon-number distributions. Lean checks the arithmetic induction.
The proof covers pure and mixed states in the two-level optical subspace.
The paper excludes orders and derives a sharp lower threshold on the optical qubit.
The sparse-state argument restricts possible counterexamples within levels zero to five.
An interval certificate covers a continuum of weak cubic gates with arbitrary Gaussian processing.
The argument restricts a witness search by classifying coordinate sets with positive compression.
Complete finite search certificates establish the reported support maxima for the specified instances.

exclusions.title: Weak multimode bound
exclusions.detail: The derivation passes mathematical review. The classical STFT change-of-window inequality already gives the claimed constant. The sharp parent question remains open.
